name: avce00
desc: Make Arc/Info (binary) Vector Coverages appear as E00
why: Converts obscure Arc/Info binary coverages to readable E00, a neat format-translation door despite being deprecated.

brief.what_it_is: AVCE00 is an open source ANSI-C library that reads and writes Arc/Info binary vector coverages as if they were E00 text files. Input is a binary coverage; output is a stream of E00 lines through AVCE00ReadNextLine() and AVCE00WriteNextLine() in the library. For users who only want conversion, the package also ships the AVCIMPORT and AVCEXPORT programs. The executables listed in the package metadata are avcdelete, avcexport, avcimport and avctest.
brief.why_it_exists: The homepage frames it as a way to make binary coverages readable through E00, so existing E00 translators can add binary coverage support by swapping in the library's read and write functions.
brief.how_it_works: The library presents a binary coverage through the same line-by-line interface as an E00 file. A translator that already reads and writes E00 can call AVCE00ReadNextLine() and AVCE00WriteNextLine() in place of its own read and write functions. The homepage describes this at a high level only and points to the library documentation for details.
brief.install_notes: The homepage offers a Windows zip (AVCE00-2.0.0-WIN32.ZIP) with precompiled AVCIMPORT and AVCEXPORT. The source package is avce00-2.0.0.tar.gz or .zip. The page gives no build steps, dependencies or configuration, so those would need to come from the library documentation, which I did not follow.
brief.standout: It is a format-translation library that makes a closed binary GIS format look like a plain text interchange format, so existing E00 tools gain binary coverage support without being rewritten. The homepage also says it is a single ANSI-C library rather than a larger GIS stack.
brief.status: Quiet. The latest release is version 2.0.0 from August 17, 2006, and the homepage was last updated August 21, 2006. The page does not say the project is abandoned. The scout note calls it deprecated, but the homepage itself does not say that.
brief.caveats: The Windows binaries are DOS executables that run under Windows 95, 98 and NT, so they are old. The homepage does not state a license beyond calling the library Open Source (Free). Bugs go to the maptools Bugzilla, and the author says he may not have time to answer every email. The page describes no features beyond conversion and the read/write functions.
quotes: AVCE00 is an Open Source (i.e. Free!) ANSI-C library that makes Arc/Info (binary) Vector Coverages appear as E00!
It allows you to read and write binary coverages just as if they were E00 files.
Comments, suggestions (and bug reports of course!) about this library are always welcome... please keep in mind that I may not have time to respond to all Emails (but I'll do my best).
